text: If you are considering studying one of our early childhood education courses in preparation for a career in childcare, then our Early Childhood Education and Care short course may be the best option for you. During the course, you will cover child development, conservation, current legislation, planning, and professional development.
Do you love kids and want to help support their well-being, learning, and development?

JTI’s child care Training courses in Melbourne will equip you with the skills you need to work or manage an early childhood education center (ECEC). In this meaningful career, you will help support children’s learning and development throughout their important early years.
We offer two early childhood education and care courses:
[CHC30121 Certificate III in Early Childhood Education and Care](/course/certificate-iii-in-early-childhood-education-and-care)
Fulfill your dream of inspiring and supporting the complete learning and development of children.
· 52 weeks
· Government funding available to eligible students
· Traineeship available
· Delivered in our Melbourne CBD
[CHC50121 Diploma in Early Childhood Education and Care](/course/diploma-of-early-childhood-education-and-care)
Learn the skills you will need to design and implement a curriculum within an early childhood education center and care service, and how to effectively supervise staff.
· 12-14 months
· Government funding available to eligible students
· Traineeship available
· Delivered in our Melbourne CBD

These courses include a mixture of theory and valuable hands-on workplace learning. First Base Training will arrange your Early Childhood Education and Care work placement at an appropriate care provider to ensure you get the skills and practice you need to work as an Early Childhood Education and Care worker.
Career pathway
JTI Training’s Early Childhood Education and Care qualifications prepare you to work in the following positions:
· Early Childhood Educator
· Family Day Care Educator
· Out of School Hours Educator
· Nanny
Why Study Your Childcare Course with JTI?

[JTI](https://jti.edu.au/) offers practical workplace training through child care courses in Melbourne, designed to accelerate your skills and help you gain employment within childcare. All of JTI's early childhood education and childcare courses are nationally recognized, with strong partnerships with Melbourne and Victorian early childhood care providers.
Join our successful graduates who are now employed within the Australian early childhood education and childcare industry as Early Childhood Educators.
